body.name: Exact two-stage elimination dossier handle
body.construction: Handle: fix \(H=2\), \(S_1=s_0\), \(\mathcal S_2=\mathcal S_3=\{0,1\}\), \(\mathcal A=\{0,1\}\), and \(\mathcal R=\{0,1,2\}\), and write \(Y_t=M_tR_t\). Enumerate the observed table coefficient by coefficient as \(x_{a_1m_1y_1s_2a_2m_2y_2s_3}=p(A_1=a_1,M_1=m_1,Y_1=y_1,S_2=s_2,A_2=a_2,M_2=m_2,Y_2=y_2,S_3=s_3)\), where \(y_t=0\) if \(m_t=0\) and \(y_t\in\mathcal R\) if \(m_t=1\). Enumerate the complete table as \(q_{a_1r_1m_1s_2a_2r_2m_2s_3}\), impose \(x_{a_1m_1y_1s_2a_2m_2y_2s_3}=\sum_{r_1:m_1r_1=y_1}\sum_{r_2:m_2r_2=y_2}q_{a_1r_1m_1s_2a_2r_2m_2s_3}\) together with the known behavior equations, and perform exact rational row reduction to \(q=q^0(x,\mu)+B(\mu)\lambda\). Substitute this parameterization into every weak-shadow cross-product. For each observable \(2\times3\) respondent shadow block \(A\), define \(D^{ij}=A_{0i}A_{1j}-A_{0j}A_{1i}\) and \(z=(D^{12},-D^{02},D^{01})\); append the continuation-value coefficient row \(c(x,\mu,\pi)\) to form \(G=\det[(A_{0\cdot});(A_{1\cdot});c^\top]\). Eliminate \(\lambda\) from the cross-products, feasibility boundaries, and the two pairs of opposite stage-face optimality systems by a lexicographic Gröbner basis or resultants. The output must be a coefficient-expanded finite list \(M_j(x,\mu,\pi)\), a declared sign vector, and the corresponding common-zero ideal; names such as ``the relevant minors'' without the displayed coefficients do not complete the obligation.
